# JOURNAL — optimizer handover (append-only, whole run)

YOU (the optimizer) own this file. It is the running, accumulating handover across ALL iterations — accepted AND rejected — and it is NEVER reset. Each iteration you APPEND one new entry at the bottom (under the marker line); you do NOT edit or delete earlier entries. Read the whole journal before proposing, so you build on EVERY prior attempt (not just the last accepted one) and never re-test a refuted idea.

You CANNOT know your own gate result while you write — the harness scores you AFTER you stop and stamps a **RESULT** line (outcome + Δ + the tasks you measurably broke/fixed, plus the ones whose move was too small to resolve) right below your entry. So do NOT write 'what worked' as a guess. To learn what actually worked, READ the framework RESULT lines of prior entries (and LEDGER.md): an entry whose RESULT says `rejected` with `broke={...}` tells you which specific edits to drop or redesign — its diff.patch is in ./prior_iterations/<id>/.

Append your entry for THIS iteration below the marker, using this shape (INTENT only — the framework appends the RESULT):

    ## Iteration <your candidate id> — <one-line headline of what you tried>
    - Changes I made (1 line per edit; name the file/tool + cluster it targets):
    - Per change, the EXPECTED effect + why it's safe (which failing task it should fix;
      why no passing task changes behavior):
    - Building on prior RESULTS: which prior entries' broke/fixed I used, and what I
      did NOT re-try because a prior RESULT showed it regressed (cite ids):
    - Refuted hypotheses (a prior RESULT proved this is NOT the fix — never re-test):
    - High-value clusters still NOT cracked (and the guard/tool designs already tried):
    - Plateau signal (are the last few RESULTs flat/negative? if so, which LEVER to switch
      to — e.g. a NEW composite tool instead of another guard, or prompt instead of code):
    - Focus next iteration:

## Iteration cand_0001 — Fix formula-sink and type-mismatch contract violations
- Changes I made:
  - guidance.md: Added "Output Contract" section with rules against formulas, requirement for typed values, and rule for minimal modification.
- Per change, the EXPECTED effect + why it's safe:
  - No formulas: Fixes FORMULA-SINK cluster (e.g., 37378, 37456) by forcing computation in Python. Safe because passing tasks already write values.
  - Typed values: Fixes TYPE-MISMATCH cluster (e.g., 416-15) by ensuring correct data types for the grader. Safe because passing tasks already use typed values.
  - Minimal modification: Fixes OVER-MODIFICATION cluster (e.g., 38462, 39046) by preventing unnecessary changes to the input file. Safe because passing tasks already minimize changes.
- Building on prior RESULTS: First iteration.
- Refuted hypotheses: None.
- High-value clusters still NOT cracked: Value-mismatch calculations (require deeper logic analysis).
- Plateau signal: N/A.
- Focus next iteration: Deep-dive into calculation errors in remaining failing tasks.

> **RESULT (framework, measured):** ACCEPTED (new champion) · val=0.675 Δ=+0.325 · fixed={37378, 38462, 416-15, 45635, 463-17, 46897, 53383, 53647, 54144, 55049, 55979, 56563, 7902, 8942, 9569} · broke={31628, 50768} · unresolved={—} (moved less than 2·SE of its own measurement — NOT evidence the edit touched those tasks; do not redesign on them).

## Iteration cand_0002 — Strengthen Output Contract and introduce Pre-Finish Verification
- Changes I made:
  - guidance.md: Clarified "Typed Values" rule to explicitly forbid datetime objects when a numeric day is requested (targets TYPE-MISMATCH, e.g., 31628).
  - guidance.md: Added "Pre-Finish Verification Checklist" requiring explicit checks for Target Range Coverage (targets OMISSION/EMPTY, e.g., 50768), Minimal Modification (targets OVER-MODIFICATION, e.g., 80-42), and No-Formula (targets FORMULA-SINK).
- Per change, the EXPECTED effect + why it's safe:
  - Date-to-Number type fix: Fixes 31628 by ensuring an int is written instead of a datetime. Safe as it only applies to "number" requests.
  - Coverage check: Fixes 50768, 37456 by forcing the agent to verify all answer cells are filled. Safe as passing tasks already fill their ranges.
  - Modification check: Fixes 80-42, 39046 by forcing the agent to revert unwanted changes. Safe as passing tasks already minimize modifications.
- Building on prior RESULTS: Built on cand_0001's contract. Fixed regressions (31628, 50768) caused by cand_0001's edits.
- Refuted hypotheses: None.
- High-value clusters still NOT cracked: Complex calculation logic errors (e.g., 51-12, 227-40).
- Plateau signal: N/A.
- Focus next iteration: Deep-dive into calculation and logic failures for the remaining set.
